contract: v6 S0 data pin: published NON-MOTION recordings used to calibrate v6. Frozen before any v6 fit.
owner_rules: Per-type parameters only; NON-MOTION data only; never gratings, direction selectivity, T4/T5 tuning or behaviour; no edge or weight change (graph 4b2f87cc...091d01).

JH2001.citation: Juusola M, Hardie RC (2001) Light adaptation in Drosophila photoreceptors: I. Response dynamics and signaling efficiency at 25 degrees C. J Gen Physiol 117(1):3-25
JH2001.licence: CC BY-NC-SA (JGP); only numbers stated in the text are used, quoted with location
JH2001.recording: intracellular voltage, R1-R6, wild type, 25 C; light impulses, steps/backgrounds BG-4..BG0, pseudorandom contrast (non-motion)

numbers.brightest_impulse: 1-ms flash ~10,000 effectively absorbed photons = ~3.3 x BG0 intensity; BG0 ~3e6 photons/s
numbers.BG1_steady_state_mV_above_rest: ~20 (Fig. 4 legend: 'BG-1 depolarizes the photoreceptors ~20 mV above the resting potential')
numbers.impulse_time_to_peak_ms: ~40 at the lowest background (BG-4) halving to ~20 at BG0 (Fig. 6H text)
numbers.dead_time_ms: ~20-25 at BG-4 to ~10 at BG0 (Fig. 6D text)

ZHENG2006.citation: Zheng L, de Polavieja GG, Wolfram V, Asyali MH, Hardie RC, Juusola M (2006) Feedback network controls photoreceptor output at the layer of first visual synapses in Drosophila. J Gen Physiol 127(5):495-510
ZHENG2006.licence: CC BY-NC-SA (JGP); only numbers stated in the text are used
ZHENG2006.recording: intracellular voltage, R1-R6 and LMCs (subtypes not separated), wild type, light pulses (non-motion)

numbers.LMC_response: transient hyperpolarisations to light pulses up to 45 mV; WT LMC maximum responses >40 mV

BORST2025.citation: Borst A (2025) Differential temporal filtering in the fly optic lobe. J Comput Neurosci 53(4):507-520
BORST2025.code: https://github.com/axelborst/temporal_filtering @ 2e277fef43139230fafc598c93301bf7b27645dd (repository carries NO licence: code is NOT copied into the repo; only the published summary numbers are cited)
BORST2025.underlying_recordings: Arenz et al. 2017 Curr Biol 27:929 (doi 10.1016/j.cub.2017.01.051) and Drews et al. 2020 Curr Biol 30:209 (doi 10.1016/j.cub.2019.10.035): two-photon CALCIUM imaging, white-noise reverse correlation (NON-MOTION), normalised impulse responses integrated to step responses
BORST2025.borst_choices_NOT_used_as_targets: Borst set every maximum to 20 mV 'arbitrarily' and added a 40% DC level to L1/L2; both are modelling choices, not data, and v6 does not use either as an absolute target
BORST2025.reconstruction_assumption: bs.bandpass(x,hp,lp) is not in the public repo; v6 assumes highpass(lowpass(x,lp),hp) with the first-order discrete filters of Borst_Fig1.py (pinned copy in the evidence dir)

not_obtained.Behnia2014: Nature 512:427, patch-clamp Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 in mV: paywalled, no released numbers found; NOT used
not_obtained.Serbe2016: Neuron 89:829, Tm1/2/4/9 calcium filters: no separate release found; covered only via Borst 2025's replot
not_obtained.Arenz2017_Drews2020_raw: raw kernels not located as a released dataset; used only through Borst 2025's published summary numbers

cell_type_mapping: MaleCNS cell_type strings map 1:1: 'R1-R6' (JH2001/ZHENG2006 photoreceptor), L1..L5 (ZHENG2006 'LMC' = L1/L2/L3 pooled, subtypes not separated by the source), Mi1, Tm3, Mi4, Mi9, Tm1, Tm2, Tm4, Tm9 (BORST2025 order). No other type is a fit target.

observation_models.photoreceptor_and_LMC_voltage: intracellular mV; the engine membrane bounds are E_inh -70 mV and E_exc 0 mV around rest -52 mV, so animal amplitudes are mapped as FRACTIONS of the available range or as ratios (stated per target); a range the engine cannot reach is reported, not hidden
observation_models.medulla_calcium: normalised calcium step responses: SHAPE and SIGN only (time course after a 50 ms first-order calcium low-pass, normalised to unit peak). They never become absolute mV targets.

split_policy: Each stage contract names its fitting targets and its held-out targets from these sources before any fit runs. Transfer-test thresholds are diagnostics, never fit objectives.
